_comment: Source of truth for content that has been VERIFIED by a named person/issue. The check script (scripts/check-verified.js, run in CI) fails the build if any 'expected' string is missing from index.html, or any 'forbidden' (previously-corrected) string reappears. Add an entry whenever someone confirms a name/fact so it can never be silently reverted again. See issue history for context.

facts.source: Confirmed by Mathew Joseph 2026-09-20; matches the Executive Committee page, which has listed Mathew Kurian as Secretary throughout
facts.note: The Content Outline named Mr. Mathew Ninan and the placeholder carried that over unchecked. Both strings are deliberately kept long: 'Mathew Ninan' on its own is a real member (page 111) and a charter family, so a bare-name guard would fire on them.

facts.note: Trustee and the committee Treasurer are one office, held by Thomas Ninan. He is also known as Reji Ninan, which is what the Leadership Team page used to print; see [committee-treasurer].
